verdicts.quote: Each due date creates reminder milestones 1, 7, and 14 calendar days later

A draft, voided or canceled invoice, fully paid or fully credited invoice, written-off invoice... or invoice on a collection hold cannot qualify... A disputed invoice is excluded while the dispute places it on a collection hold.
verdicts.missing: Whether an invoice on a payment plan stops or continues receiving reminders is never stated (part-paid continuing is settled by C-20).

verdicts.quote: For an invoice with 25.00 USD remaining on a 100.00 USD original total, the email identifies 25.00 USD as the amount currently due.
The same account, invoice, and milestone ordinal produce no further submission after a restart, pause, re-enable, recipient edit, due-date edit, payment reversal, or re-deployment.

commit a change before its email submission begins. The feature uses the current account activation, deployment stop, invoice disposition, collectible balance... If any required condition fails... submission does not start.
the earliest a still-eligible retry can start is 1 hour after non-acceptance is established.
verdicts.missing: Retries (C-43, C-44) and outage recovery (C-16) are covered, but no person is notified or alerted when sends keep failing. Failures are only visible in activity (C-93) and health views (C-70).

verdicts.quote: If the live email service restricts throughput or concurrent submissions, work above its admitted capacity waits for later consideration.
Only day seven is considered for submission at activation, and day fourteen becomes the candidate when it opens.
A November 21 milestone cannot send before November 21 at 09:00 UTC and is due at that instant. Daylight saving changes and account locale do not shift that instant.
The reminder email shows the outstanding amount in the invoice currency
verdicts.missing: How the amount and currency are formatted for the recipient (locale, symbol, decimal conventions).

verdicts.quote: An invoice-specific address that is present but invalid is held for correction. A missing or ambiguous customer fallback is held for correction.

use the linked customer's current billing email for that account if there is exactly one designated address... A missing or ambiguous customer fallback is held for correction. No reminder is copied to other recipients.
Each attempt exposes its start timestamp, destination, result, and result timestamp when known.
If the original invoice has a customer-facing payment link or instructions, the reminder gives access to that same payment route.
verdicts.missing: Reference, amount and due date are covered (C-86, C-26, C-27), but the spec never says whether the payment link expires or what happens if it has.

verdicts.quote: A user without billing settings authority cannot enable or disable reminders for that account.
After the deployment-wide stop takes effect, new reminders cease across all accounts.
verdicts.missing: There is a global stop and a per-account switch, but no per-customer opt-out and no preview or dry-run of upcoming sends. Manual resends are left to existing rules (C-75).

verdicts.quote: The activity distinguishes upcoming, due, held for invoice data, ineligible for collection, skipped while a later milestone is open, submitting, retry scheduled, accepted, failed, uncertain, superseded
Delivery capacity may delay it. There is no fixed product dispatch deadline during saturation.
creates no charge, payment, credit, write-off, or reversal. The amount, currency, balance, due date, and invoice lifecycle status remain as set by billing.
